name: Disneyland Mint Julep Bar Warm Mickey-Shaped Powdered Sugar Beignets
brandOrRestaurant: Mint Julep Bar & Tiana's Palace (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Airy, hollow choux-style yeast pastry pillows dusted with powdered sugar have almost zero weight or fiber per beignet—making a single warm Mickey beignet a surprisingly light remission treat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share a 3-pack of classic Powdered Sugar Mickey Beignets while warm (avoid citrus/lemon or berry-seed seasonal dipping sauces and skip the lime-heavy Mint Julep drink!).
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS WARNING: Do NOT order the New Orleans Mint Julep drink (made with pure limeade & lemon juice); stick to classic powdered-sugar beignets with water
